summary: Narrow shaded dead-end by driveways; Loading Zone, little room, homes 13 m.
reasons: Narrow tree-lined dead end, no room beside lane

best_section.where: Austral Street east side, short dead-end past the bend by the riverside houses

drivers.seclusion: Houses and apartments 13-15 m away on both sides; river bush beyond the end.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane that looks like a shared driveway; no clear shoulder, so a van would block the lane.
drivers.traffic: Dead end with almost no through traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars on the stretch; Loading Zone signs apply.

flags: Loading Zone signs at both ends
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, Brisbane River 133 m away
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the stretch, strongest to the north and east.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is private driveway access
